label: Creation
notes: Myths concerning the origin of the cosmos, the world, or life

label: Global Flood
notes: Narratives of a world-deluging flood as purification or destruction

label: Underworld Journey
notes: Voyage to the realm of the dead, often for knowledge or rescue

label: Trickster Cycle
notes: Exploits of a deity, human, or animal who subverts order, often culturally creative

label: Hero's Journey (Campbellian)
notes: Follows Campbell's monomyth pattern: call → trials → transformation → return

label: Apotheosis
notes: Elevation of a mortal to divine status or transformation into a star/constellation

label: World Axis/Tree
notes: Cosmic pillar, mountain, or tree (Axis Mundi) connecting different realms (heaven, earth, underworld)

label: Cosmological Structure
notes: Myths describing the structure, layers, and nature of the universe

label: Sacred Marriage (Hieros Gamos)
notes: Symbolic union of deities, often sky and earth, ensuring fertility or cosmic order

label: Divine Combat
notes: Battle between gods or cosmic forces, often establishing or challenging cosmic order

label: Celestial Phenomena
notes: Myths explaining eclipses, comets, constellations, or actions of celestial bodies as omens or deities

label: Ancestor Veneration
notes: Importance of ancestral figures, lineage, and their influence on the living

label: Metamorphosis
notes: Significant transformation of beings (gods, humans, animals) into other forms

label: Forbidden Act/Transgression
notes: Narratives centered on the violation of a taboo or divine law and its consequences

label: Golden Age/Paradise Lost
notes: Myths about a primordial idyllic state and its subsequent loss or decline

label: Origin/Theft of Fire
notes: Myths explaining how humanity acquired fire, often through theft or a gift from gods

label: Origin of Death
notes: Etiological myths explaining how mortality entered the world

label: Order vs. Chaos
notes: Overarching theme of conflict between forces of cosmic order and primordial chaos

label: Prophecy and Fate
notes: Role of prophecies, predestination, and attempts to thwart fate

label: Eternal Return
notes: Cyclical conceptions of time, cosmic renewal, and recurring patterns

label: Taboo
notes: Social or religious custom prohibiting or restricting a particular practice or association with a person, place, or thing
